description.value: The Greenwood Museum Archives & Visitor Centre sits in Greenwood, BC, recognized as the smallest city in Canada, making it a singular cultural stop along a cycling route through the Boundary Country. The museum covers local mining, forestry, and Japanese-Canadian history, and offers a self-guided Heritage Walking Tour with maps available at the front desk. It also serves as the regional visitor centre, stocking provincial and local publications useful for cyclists planning onward routes.
